exposure: Number of antenatal care visits (more than 3/3 or fewer)
cohort: 4,092 married non-pregnant Bangladeshi mothers who had at least one child aged 2 years or younger
finding: The prevalence of early initiation of breastfeeding among Bangladeshi mothers was 51.4%, and several geographical and socio-demographic factors were associated with early initiation of breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Mothers who delivered by caesarean section were less likely to practice early initiation of breastfeeding.
